**Stop.** Do not file public issues for security vulnerabilities.

Public disclosure before a fix is shipped puts every CivicCast deployment at risk - including school boards, HOA boards, public access TV stations, and small nonprofits running broadcast infrastructure on this code.

Please follow the private disclosure process documented in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md).

If you have already started filling out this form, please close the issue without submitting and email the report instead.
